title: Preserve a decimal’s individual scale in an Avro bytes field
summary: Avro’s new converter preserved the scale difference between 12.3 and 12.30. It read a standalone encoding as 12.30 but decoded a slice exposing identical bytes as the preceding 7.

change.description: The new Java logical type `big-decimal` carries each value’s unscaled integer and scale in its encoded bytes. A schema can now describe both 12.3 and 12.30 without choosing a shared scale.

notes: The two views expose the same byte sequence, and the prefix is itself one complete encoding. The comparison needs no assumption about interoperability with another language.
